name: 采购的实时报告和监控 (1JI)
name_en: Real-Time Reporting and Monitoring for Procurement (1JI)
description_en_html:
Overview

At a glance, the Procurement Overview Page displays the most important information and tasks relevant for a purchaser. All the relevant information is shown on a single page – visualized attractively and efficiently on actionable cards for multiple types of content. The user-friendly experience makes viewing, filtering, and acting upon data simple, faster and smarter – even on mobile devices. Analytical list pages are also provided to monitor purchase contract items, supplier confirmation, and purchase order items.

The purchaser views a high-level overview of important information, such as expiring contracts, overdue purchase orders or urgent purchase requisitions as well as an overview of different procurement KPIs. With these KPIs, the purchaser can easily determine the performance of suppliers, monitor non-managed spend or purchasing spend, and quickly discover trends and potential areas of improvement.

Key Process Flow

  • Display urgent contracts, overdue purchase order items, urgent purchase requisition items, or open RFQs with impending submission deadlines
  • Navigate quickly to an object page or list app to perform a required action
  • Analyze purchasing spend, non-managed spend, and off-contract spend by supplier or material group
  • Analyze supplier performance based on their operational score in correlation with the corresponding spend
  • Display purchasing spend or supplier performance in line charts for the last 12 months
  • Analyze purchase requisition item types and purchase requisition touch rate for the last 12 months
  • Navigate from the KPI insights to the corresponding smart apps for detailed analysis
  • Filter cards by different business attributes, such as Supplier, Material, Material Group, Purchasing Group, Purchasing Organization, Plant, and so on

Business Benefits

  • Provide a dashboard for the purchaser to perform daily activities smoothly and without opening different reports and transactions
  • Provide high-level insights for a purchaser to understand the key numbers and drill down to action
  • Filter by supplier, purchasing group, or material group, for example to show urgent contracts, purchase requisition items, spend, or supplier performance information
description_zh_html:
概览

采购概览页面一目了然，显示与采购员相关的最重要的信息和任务。所有相关信息都显示在一个页面上 - 在可操作卡上以极具吸引力和高效的方式显示多种类型的内容。用户友好的体验使查看、过滤和对数据进行操作变得简单、更快速、更智能，甚至可以在移动设备上进行。还提供分析列表页面以监控采购合同项目、供应商确认和采购订单项目。

采购员查看重要信息的高级概览，例如到期合同、逾期采购订单或紧急采购申请以及不同采购 KPI 的概览。通过这些 KPI，采购员可以轻松确定供应商的绩效，监控非管理支出或采购支出，并快速发现趋势和潜在的改进领域。

关键流程流

  • 显示紧急合同、逾期采购订单项目、紧急采购申请项目或即将提交截止日期的未清询价
  • 快速导航到对象页面或清单应用，以执行所需操作
  • 按供应商或物料组分析采购支出、非管理支出和合同外支出
  • 根据与相应支出相关的运营分数，分析供应商绩效
  • 在折线图中显示过去 12 个月的采购支出或供应商绩效
  • 分析过去 12 个月的采购申请项目类型和采购申请接触率
  • 从 KPI 洞察导航到相应的智能应用以进行详细分析
  • 按不同的业务属性（例如供应商、物料、物料组、采购组、采购组织、工厂等）过滤卡

业务优势

  • 为采购员提供仪表盘，以便顺利地执行日常活动，而无需打开不同的报表和事务
  • 为采购员提供高级洞察，帮助其了解关键数字并采取相应操作
  • 例如，按供应商、采购组或物料组过滤以显示紧急合同、采购申请项目、支出或供应商绩效信息
